divergences.summary: This asset (210648) carries fourteen #REF! formula-error literals in its call-sign column where the clean same-vintage twin ofcom-2021-01 (asset 214225, counterpart hash ebd4143c…) carries valid call signs and zero error cells. The two are same-vintage register exports but differ in shape and scope — this copy is the minimal three-column Value/Status/Type export (146,469 rows) and the twin is a wider six-column export (146,763 rows, +294) — so the comparison is at register level, not byte or aligned-cell level. The material divergence, and the reason this corrupt copy is held, is the fourteen broken CONCATENATE(#REF!,#REF!) call-sign cells; the corruption is upstream in Ofcom's published file, proven by this web-archive capture (2021-01-10) and an independent Internet Archive capture of the same asset the next day (2021-01-11). No repair or substitution is applied: the #REF! cells are carried verbatim as unkeyable-class records and flagged spreadsheet-error-token.
divergences.enumeration: Fourteen corrupt call-sign cells in this asset's single sheet, each published as CONCATENATE(#REF!,#REF!) cached to the error value #REF!: A1801 (Allocated), A2405 (Allocated), A5708 (Allocated), A6352 (Allocated), A7464 (Allocated), A50012 (Allocated), A59764 (Allocated), A63856 (Allocated), A72944 (Allocated), A77907 (Allocated), A133723 (Allocated), A138302 (Reserved), A141343 (Reserved), A143282 (Allocated) — twelve Allocated, two Reserved (42 #REF! tokens in the sheet XML: two per formula plus one cached value, across the fourteen cells). The clean twin holds valid call signs and no #REF! cells for the same vintage; because the two exports differ in shape and row scope, the individual corrupt rows are not positionally aligned to specific twin rows and are deliberately NOT reconstructed.

sheetsIndicative.note: one worksheet (extractor slug 'sheet1'): header Value,Status,Type then 146,469 data rows in the minimal three-column register shape. Status vocabulary Allocated (95,944), Reserved (50,240), Available (275) and blank (10); Type is 'Call Sign - Amateur' on every row. No licence-class or date column. Fourteen Value cells are the formula-error literal #REF! (broken CONCATENATE(#REF!,#REF!)); apart from those, every call sign is distinct.

witnesses.note: fetched via the archive's identity replay (the 20210110045626id_ modifier), which serves the captured raw bytes; the bare-timestamp replay returns an HTML wrapper, not the file.

raw-extract-sheet-1-sheet1.csv.contentsIndicative: mechanical extract of the single sheet; header Value,Status,Type then 146,469 rows. The fourteen #REF! error cells are rendered verbatim from their cached formula-error value (the extractor carries a t="e" error cell's cached token, never dropping or guessing it). Three call signs carry a trailing non-breaking space (G0TQK, G7IWE, 2E1HON), as in the clean twin. No date columns.

normalised--sheet-1-sheet1.csv.contentsIndicative: header callsign,status,licence_class; 146,469 rows sorted by callsign (source order carries no meaning - no dates). Status carried verbatim (10 blanks preserved); licence_class emitted empty throughout (this three-column shape discloses no class). The constant Type column is required-present but not carried. The fourteen #REF! call-sign values are carried verbatim as unkeyable-class records (they sort first, '#' being an early codepoint, and share the single '#REF!' key); the call-sign parser flags each spreadsheet-error-token. No repair or substitution. Three trailing non-breaking spaces are trimmed and counted (G0TQK, G7IWE, 2E1HON) - the only canonicalisation; G0TQK and G7IWE each also occur as a bare-callsign row, so those two collapse onto duplicate keys (an honest consequence of trimming, preserved), while 2E1HON's is unique.
